messages:
Priya (Procurement): Mateo from LedgerFlow sent a credits-based quote. main asks: how credits map to tokens/embeddings, invoice granularity, and rollover rules.
Mateo - LedgerFlow: hi all  baseline mapping: 1 credit = 1k tokens OR 10 embedding units. long-context multiplier applies >2048 tokens (1.5x).
Amelia (Finance): need a sample invoice CSV with fields invoice_id, period, commit, used_credits, overage, unit_price, tax, total. net-45 for a pilot ok?
Mateo - LedgerFlow: net-45 ok for pilot with PO. sample invoice will be attached: "Commit 150,000 credits = $45,000; Overage 7,320 credits = $2,196; Setup VPC = $5,000; Tax = $2,655; Total = $54,851".
Jon S (Eng Ops): can you push per-request logs to our S3 (request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, billable_credits, ts)? we need per-route mapping.
Mateo - LedgerFlow: yes  s3 push or presigned link. logs include billable_credits after multipliers and cache deductions.
Sasha R (Platform): rollover policy? last vendor expired credits quarterly and it was painful.
Mateo - LedgerFlow: options: quarterly with 30% rollover, or annual with full rollover (small maintenance fee).
Amelia (Finance): termination/refund? legal will ask.
Mateo - LedgerFlow: 30-day notice for pilots; annual contracts pro-rata refund if >6 months remain.
Priya (Procurement): setup fee listed at $5k. negotiable for a 12mo commit?
Mateo - LedgerFlow: can reduce to $2,500 with a 12-month annual commit.
Priya (Procurement): Accounting Bot  once Mateo uploads the CSV, please run the parser and flag any mismapped fields.
Accounting Bot: will run dry parse on uploaded CSV and post mapping diffs in ~1.5hrs.
Jon S (Eng Ops): next step for eng: we'll run our 1.2M token sample through your log format and post any parsing issues.
Sasha R (Platform): I'll validate BYOK and region routing for EU.
Mateo - LedgerFlow: thanks  uploading mock invoice + multiplier table in ~45m. holding the $2.5k concession for 48h. ping if you want a quick sync. :handshake:
